name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  July 23, 2026

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted at City Hall, Council Chambers,
9th Floor, on July 23, 2026, at 2:30 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration Department
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Sgt. Francisco Ruiz, Inglewood Police Department
  Captain Reggie Johnson, Fire Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Crystal McGlover, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:  Destinee Wesley, City Clerk Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department
  Mayra Perez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments, any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Harjinder Singh asked whether any persons present wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Harjinder Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on July 09, 2026

Permit(s):

Item #1:  Sharis Rhodes on behalf of Think True of In to host One Event at 106 E. Manchester
  Blvd., Private Property, on Friday, July 31, 2026, from 8:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. and
  Saturday, August 1, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 9:30 p.m. Approval for a two (2) day event
  within the Jordan Dome. Applicant is responsible for crowd control, event clean-up, and
  all applicable mitigation measures; Applicant shall staff this event with thirty (30)
  professional/licensed security guards on each event day to ensure the safety of
  attendees, the location, and for traffic control. All security personnel shall wear reflective
  vests to be readily identifiable to attendees or the general public. No blocking traffic on
  Manchester Blvd or La Brea Avenue. No blocking of fire lanes or emergency
  ingress/egress. Pedestrian foot traffic on sidewalks must be unobstructed and safe at
  all times. The IPD watch commander will be notified, and extra patrol and high visibility
  will be provided as time permits; Adhere to all local, state, and federal laws; Applicant to
  hire four (4) TCO's for traffic control at drop-off areas; PW approved it with the condition
  that sidewalks and streets must be free of any obstruction during the event; No
   additional recommendations needed for Fire approval. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No.282480).

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
